title: Dhātu
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Yo bhikkhave pathavidhātuyā chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || 4-8 Yo āpodhātuya || Yo tejodhātuyā || Yo vāyodhātuya || Yo ākāsadhātuyā || Yo viññāṇadhātuyā chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || 9 Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno imesu chasu ṭhānesu cetaso upakkileso pahīno hoti || nekkhammaninnaṃ cassa cittaṃ hoti nekkhamma paribhāvitaṃ cittaṃ kammaniyaṃ khāyati abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesūti || ||
